fact: The AFD-funded PGEC project, running 2019-2024 with the education ministry, lists deployment and operationalisation of the Système d'Information et de Gestion de l'Education (SIGE) among its impacts.

UNICEF Comores says e-Msomo, the national education management platform built by the ministry with ANADEN, is in use and holds over 80,000 pupils, 700 schools and 3,000 teachers in one national database.
